footer.about: EduBridge connects learners with vetted instructors for live cohort classes and one-on-one sessions, from professional exams to university courses.
footer.teachBody: Run cohorts or one-on-one sessions, set your hourly rate and get paid through the platform.

hero.body: Prepare for professional exams, keep up with university courses or master a specific topic. Join a scheduled cohort or book a private session at a time that suits you.

how.body: Every training on EduBridge is delivered live by a vetted instructor. Pick the format that fits how you learn best.
how.cohortBody: Join a group on a fixed schedule with a set price per seat. Enrol before the deadline while seats last.
how.oneBody: Pick an instructor and a time that works for you. You are only charged once the instructor accepts.
how.recordingsBody: Rewatch sessions and download the materials your instructor shares.
how.feedbackBody: Get clear notes on strengths, areas to improve and next steps.

categories.body: Whether you're sitting a professional exam, keeping up with a university module or picking up a new skill, start with the category that fits.
categories.specificTopicHint: Focused skills, from Python to public speaking

cta.body: Run cohorts or one-on-one sessions, set your own hourly rate and get paid through EduBridge.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your EduBridge account
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't finish. Try again, or use your email and password.

mfa.title: Check your authenticator app
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code to finish signing in. This extra step protects instructor and admin accounts.

auth.mockHint: Demo accounts (mock API): learner@example.com, instructor@example.com or admin@example.com with password Password123!. Code for instructor and admin: 123456.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join live cohort classes or book one-on-one sessions with vetted instructors.
register.name: Full name
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase is easier to remember.
register.consent: I agree to the <terms>Terms of service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
register.timezone: We'll show session times in {zone}. You can change this later.
register.googleConsent: By continuing with Google you'll be asked to accept our terms before you start.

verify.checkSubtitle: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
verify.checkSubtitleNoEmail: Open the confirmation link we emailed you to activate your account.
verify.checkTips: The link works for 24 hours. If you can't find it, check spam or promotions.
verify.resent: Done. If that address is waiting for confirmation, a new link is on its way.
verify.verifyingSubtitle: One moment while we activate your account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {email} has an EduBridge account, a reset link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You'll use it to sign in from now on. Other devices will be signed out.
reset.success: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This page needs the link from your reset email. Request a new one below.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.subtitle: Please review and accept how EduBridge works and how we handle your data.
consent.updatedSubtitle: We've updated our terms. Please review and accept them to keep using EduBridge.
consent.checkbox: I've read and agree to the Terms of service and Privacy policy.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be broken or the page may have moved.

learner.intro: Your trainings, upcoming sessions and bookings will show here.
learner.emptyTitle: You haven't enrolled in anything yet
learner.emptyBody: Browse cohorts that start soon or book a one-on-one session with an instructor at a time that suits you.

instructor.intro: Booking requests, today's sessions and your earnings will show here.
instructor.emptyBody: Once learners can book you, new requests appear here with the time left to respond. Set your weekly availability so learners can find open slots.

admin.intro: Users, enrolments, revenue, active cohorts and pending one-on-one requests will show here.
admin.emptyBody: Start by creating the catalogue: categories, then trainings and their pricing rules. Metrics appear as soon as learners enrol.

notices.finishBody: Tell us your goals and background so instructors can prepare and we can suggest the right trainings.
notices.pendingBody: We check every instructor's ID and qualifications, usually within two working days. We'll email you when you're approved and your profile goes live.
notices.rejectedTitle: We couldn't approve your profile yet
notices.rejectedBody: Check your email for what's missing. Reply to that email and we'll take another look.

onboarding.laterToast: Saved. You can finish your profile any time from your dashboard.
onboarding.laterFailed: We couldn't save that. Check your connection and try again.

learner.title: Set up your learning profile
learner.intro: Three short steps so instructors know who they're teaching and we can suggest the right trainings. You can change any of this later.
learner.doneToast: You're all set. Let's find your first training.

instructor.title: Set up your teaching profile
instructor.intro: Tell learners who you are and get verified. Our team reviews every instructor before their profile goes live, usually within two working days.

profile.name: Full name
profile.headline: Headline
profile.headlineHint: One line learners see under your name, e.g. "Chartered accountant, 8 years teaching ICAN".
profile.bioHint: Your experience, how you teach and who you help most. {count} of at least 80 characters.
profile.timezoneHint: Session times are shown in this zone.

goals.goals: What do you want to achieve?
goals.goalsHint: For example: "Pass ICAN Skills level by May" or "Get comfortable with calculus before my first semester".
goals.topicsHint: Press Enter after each one. Up to 10.

background.examDateHint: If you're preparing for an exam, we'll keep your sessions on track for it.

expertise.subjectsHint: Press Enter after each one. Learners search by these. Up to 15.
expertise.qualificationsHint: Degrees, professional certifications or other credentials. You'll upload proof in the next step.

verification.privacy: These documents are only seen by the EduBridge review team and are never shown on your profile.
verification.idDescription: Passport, driver's licence or national ID card. Make sure your name and photo are clear.
verification.credDescription: Proof of the qualifications you listed. Up to 5 files.

payout.intro: We pay your earnings through Stripe. You'll enter your bank details on Stripe's secure pages, so EduBridge never sees or stores them.
payout.notStarted: Connect a payout account to get paid for your sessions.
payout.pending: Stripe is still checking your details. You can continue where you left off.
payout.returned: Welcome back. Your payout details are saved.

availability.intro: Set the times you usually teach each week. Learners see these converted to their own time zone, and you'll confirm each request before it's booked.

review.intro: Check everything is complete, then submit your profile for review. We'll email you when it's approved.
review.missing: A few steps still need finishing before you can submit.

submitted.title: Thanks, we're reviewing your profile
submitted.body: Our team checks every instructor's ID and qualifications, usually within two working days. We'll email you as soon as you're approved. Meanwhile you can look around your dashboard.
